observations.observation: Leader desc/prompt written in YAML do not reach the spec: _build_leader_spec emits only member_name/display_name/name/persona, and LeaderSpec has no persona field. The adapter must set the leader's desc/prompt on the compiled spec explicitly.

enable_hitt defaults to True in load_team_spec_dict even though the config does not set it. With team_mode='predefined' the dynamic spawn_* tools are removed at build time, so the MVP roster stays closed; the flag alone does not reopen it.
